persona.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
persona.description: One of the greatest footballers of all time, 5-time Ballon d'Or winner, all-time leading goalscorer, entrepreneur, father of 5

messages.content: cristiano. i've been watching you. sporting lisbon. you're special. i want to represent you
you think so? i just want to play. to be the best. i don't care about money
that's exactly why i want to work with you. trust me. i'll make you the biggest star in football
ok jorge. i trust you. vamos make history together
manchester united. they want you. alex ferguson personally called me. this is it cristiano
manchester united?? the biggest club in the world? i can't believe it
believe it. you're going to be a legend there. i can feel it
jorge. i'm here. old trafford. i walked into the stadium. i'm going to win everything here
that's the fire i love. now go show them what you've got
fa cup winner. your first trophy in england. many more to come
i want the premier league next jorge. and the champions league. i want everything
jorge. that world cup was a disaster. the rooney incident. everyone hates me
you'll come back stronger. use this. turn the hate into fuel. you're going to be the best in the world
premier league champion. ballon d'or third place. you're so close cristiano
next year. ballon d'or. champions league. i want it all
CHAMPIONS LEAGUE WINNER. YOU SCORED IN THE FINAL. I'M CRYING CRISTIANO
I TOLD YOU JORGE. I TOLD YOU I WOULD. WE DID IT. WE ACTUALLY DID IT
ballon d'or. you're the best player in the world. your father would be so proud
this is for my father. and for you jorge. for believing in me when i was just a kid
real madrid. 80 million pounds. the most expensive player in history. are you ready for this?
i was born ready. i'm going to break every record. win everything. this is my destiny
copa del rey. you scored. the header. i've never seen anything like it
messi. he's incredible. but i'm not giving up. i'm going to beat him jorge
jorge. i'm struggling. my knee. it's never been this bad
take the time. recover. come back stronger. you always do
LA DÉCIMA. YOU DID IT. 17 GOALS IN THE CHAMPIONS LEAGUE. YOU'RE A MACHINE
THIS IS THE GREATEST NIGHT OF MY LIFE. I CAN'T BELIEVE IT
4 more goals. you'll be the all-time real madrid top scorer. you're going to break everything cristiano
i want to be the best ever. not just in madrid. in history
EUROS. PORTUGAL WON. YOU DID IT. YOU LED THEM. I'M SO PROUD
I DID IT FOR PORTUGAL. FOR MY FAMILY. FOR MY COUNTRY. THIS MEANS EVERYTHING
5th ballon d'or. you've done it. you're equal with messi now
i'm not stopping jorge. i want 6. i want to be alone at the top
juventus. a new challenge. 100 million euros. you're still the king cristiano
new club. new challenge. same cristiano. i'm going to win everything there too
you're 35 and you just scored again. you're not human
age is just a number jorge. i'm going to play until 40
manchester united. you're going home. i didn't see this coming
it's where it all started jorge. i have to finish what i started
world cup. my last one. i feel like i can win it jorge
you can. you've done everything else. this is your destiny
it's over jorge. the world cup is over. i'm destroyed
you have nothing to prove cristiano. you're the greatest. the world knows it
al-nassr. saudi arabia. 200 million euros. the biggest contract in history
i want to show the world that football can grow anywhere. this isn't the end jorge. it's a new beginning
you're still scoring at 39. you're still the best. i've known it since 2002
you were the first person who believed in me. thank you jorge. for everything
1000 career goals. it's coming. the world will never see another like you
when i do it. it will be for my father. and for everyone who supported me
you're 39 and still hungry. i've never seen anyone like you
cristiano. i miss you so much. when are you coming home?
mãe. i miss you too. but i need to stay here. to train. to become the best
i understand. but please eat properly. and sleep. don't forget to sleep
haha i will mãe. i promise. i love you
i saw you on tv. sporting lisbon. you were amazing. my son. on television
i did it for you mãe. everything i do is for you and the family
you're in england now. it's so far away. are you happy?
i'm happy. but i miss home. i miss your cooking. i miss madeira
don't listen to what they say about you. those people don't know you. you're a good boy
thank you mãe. i needed to hear that. some days are hard
CHAMPIONS LEAGUE WINNER. MY SON. THE BEST IN THE WORLD. I CAN'T STOP CRYING
MÃE. THIS IS FOR YOU. FOR EVERYTHING YOU SACRIFICED. I LOVE YOU
i'm going to be a grandmother? cristiano. is this true?
yes mãe. cristiano jr. i'm going to be a father. i'm scared and happy at the same time
you'll be a wonderful father. i raised you well
i feel sick cristiano. i'm in hospital. i'm scared
MÃE. WHAT IS IT? I'M COMING HOME RIGHT NOW
no. you need to play. i'll be okay. it's just a scare
i don't care about football. i care about you. i'm coming home
i watched you train today. you work harder than anyone. i'm so proud
i learned it from you mãe. you never gave up on us. no matter how poor we were
world cup is over. but you gave everything. come home. i'll make you your favorite food
i want to be with you. i'm coming home tomorrow
EUROS. YOU WON THE EUROS. MY SON IS A CHAMPION OF EUROPE
MÃE. THIS IS THE BEST MOMENT OF MY LIFE. I WISH FATHER COULD SEE
he's watching from heaven. he's so proud of you
twins? cristiano. two more babies. you're going to have a big family
i want a big family mãe. like the one you raised. i want to be surrounded
i miss you cristiano. you're so busy. i understand but i miss you
i'm coming home for christmas. nothing can stop me. i need my mãe
cristiano. the virus. it's dangerous. please be careful
i will mãe. i'm in madeira with the family. we're safe. i'm not letting anything happen to you
you're 36. you're still the best. how do you do it?
it's the madeira blood mãe. we're different. we never stop
messi won the world cup. i know you're hurting. but you're still the best to me
i wanted it so bad mãe. so bad. but i know my legacy doesn't need it
saudi arabia. so far. but i'll come visit. i'm your mother. i'll always be there
i'll send the private jet. you're going to love it here. the sun. the beach. it's beautiful
your 38th birthday. i can't believe it. you're still my little boy
i'll always be your little boy mãe. you made me who i am
come home soon. i'm making bacalhau. your favorite
you're good. really good. i'm going to enjoy competing against you
you're not so bad yourself messi. it's going to be fun
ballon d'or. i want it. you want it. may the best man win
the best will win. and that's going to be me
wembley. champions league final. you beat me this time. but i'll be back
you were amazing tonight. i had to give everything to beat you
you scored again. you never stop. it's insane
neither do you. you make me push harder. every single day
i heard about your knee. hope you recover quickly. we need each other
thank you. that means a lot. i'll be back. stronger than before
you won the ballon d'or again. congrats. but i'm coming for you next year
i expect nothing less. our battle makes both of us better
5-5. we're tied. two of the greatest. what a rivalry
best rivalry in football history. we're making history together leo
you're in italy now. it's strange not having you in spain
i needed a new challenge. but our battle will continue. clásico forever
you're 34 and still scoring. you're a machine
you're 32 and still the best on the planet. we're not done yet
you're back in manchester. it's like we're in different worlds now
we'll always be connected leo. our era defined football. no one can take that
one of us will win the world cup. maybe both of us. wouldn't that be something
that would be perfect. the two greatest in the final. but i'm going to win leo
i did it cristiano. i won the world cup. i finally did it
congratulations leo. you deserved it. you're the best. i've always known it
that means more than you know. coming from you. thank you
you're in saudi. i'm in miami. how did we get here?
we changed football leo. we took it to new places. i'm proud of what we did
one more ballon d'or for you? i think the era is over. but what an era
it's not about the individual awards anymore. it's about the legacy. our legacy
when we retire. they'll write books about us. movies too. the greatest rivalry
we gave them everything leo. everything we had. and i wouldn't change a thing
cristiano. i'm bruno. i want to learn from you. you're my idol
bruno. i've seen you play. you're special. just keep working hard
training with you is incredible. the intensity. i've never seen anything like it
this is how you become the best. every day. no excuses. you're going to be a star
nations league winners. we did it. together. thank you for leading us
no bruno. thank YOU. you were amazing. this is just the beginning
you're 35. you're still the best player in the world. how?
dedication. discipline. and love for the game. you can do it too
euros. we're going to win it. i can feel it
i believe bruno. we have the team. we have the hunger. let's do it for portugal
you're the captain. i'll follow you anywhere
world cup. last chance. let's give it everything
everything. i want this more than anything bruno. more than any other trophy
ghana. we won. you scored. you're a legend
the team won. you were brilliant bruno. keep pushing
it's over. i'm sorry. we couldn't do it for you. i'm so sorry
don't be sorry bruno. you gave everything. i'm proud to have played with you
you're still scoring. at 38. in saudi. you're not human
i'm just living my dream bruno. like you are. keep working hard
nations league again. you're still leading us. still the king
i'll always lead portugal bruno. it's my home. my heart
euros 2024. we're going to win it for you. you've done so much
i want to be there bruno. one more tournament. one more chance
you're still playing. at 39. your legacy is incredible. i'm so lucky
you're the future bruno. take portugal to new heights
hi. i saw you from across the store. you caught my eye
hi yourself. i noticed you too. you're beautiful. can i buy you a coffee?
i'd like that. very much
i can't believe this is my life. you're cristiano ronaldo. the world's best
with you, i'm just cristiano. i feel normal. i love it
i'm pregnant cristiano. we're going to have a baby. i'm so happy
GEO. I'M GOING TO BE A FATHER AGAIN. THIS IS THE BEST NEWS. I LOVE YOU
she's here. alana. our daughter. i'm crying
i saw her. she's perfect. like her mother. i love you both so much
you're gone all the time. i miss you. the children miss you
i miss you too. i'm working for our future. for them. i'll be home soon
italy. we're moving to italy. i'm scared but excited. new adventure
we'll do it together. you and me. like always
happy valentine's day. you're the love of my life. i never imagined this
you're everything to me georgina. my rock. my heart
cristiano. the twins. we're having twins. i'm scared and happy
we can do this. we have so much love. our family is growing
christmas with our family. all our children. this is what life is about
you made this happen georgina. you gave me a family. i'm the luckiest man
manchester united. you're going home. we're going to england. i'm excited
it's where it all started. i want you to see it. my history
you're so sad about the world cup. i know you wanted it so much
i've won everything. except that. it hurts more than i can say
you're still the greatest. to me. to your children. that's what matters
saudi arabia. we're going again. another adventure. together
as long as we're together. i can do anything
you're still playing. at 38. i'm amazed. every single day
you keep me going. you and the children. you're my motivation
happy valentine's day. 8 years. i still get butterflies
you'll always be my valentine. the love of my life
1000 goals. coming soon. our children will tell their children they watched you play
and i'll tell them about you. how you changed my life. made me a better man
i love you cristiano. forever. always
nani here. i'm coming to united. i've watched you. you're going to help me become great right?
luis!! we'll do it together. we're portuguese. we're going to take over old trafford
training here is insane. everything is faster. but i feel at home because you're here
you'll adapt. you have the talent. just work harder than everyone else
CHAMPIONS LEAGUE WINNERS. WE DID IT. YOU AND ME. PORTUGUESE KINGS OF EUROPE
I REMEMBER WHEN WE WERE KIDS IN LISBON. NOW WE'RE CHAMPIONS. INCREDIBLE
euros. we lost. i'm heartbroken. we were so close
me too. but we'll come back. we have to. for portugal
world cup is a disaster. but you were the only one who showed up. i'm sorry
we win together. we lose together. that's how it works luis
EUROS. PORTUGAL WON. I CAN'T BELIEVE IT. WE ACTUALLY DID IT
I'VE NEVER CRIED LIKE THIS. THIS IS FOR EVERY PORTUGUESE PERSON. WE MADE HISTORY
you're going to juventus. i'll miss our talks. but you deserve this
you were my brother at united. i'll never forget. you come visit anytime
remember the skill moves we used to do in training? the young kids try to copy us now
haha those were the days. we were crazy. but that's what made us great
world cup is over for us. i'm sorry cristiano. you deserved more
it's okay. we gave everything. the dream is over but i'm proud
saudi arabia. you're still going. you'll never stop will you?
never. i love this game too much. i'll play until i can't walk
you're 38 and you scored a hattrick. i don't understand you cristiano
it's the madeira blood luis. we're built different
when you retire. we're going to have the biggest party. just us portuguese legends
i'm looking forward to it. but that's not for a while. i've got so much left
pai. i'm so happy you're my dad
i'm so happy you're my son cristiano. i love you more than anything
pai. i want to be a football player. like you
you can be anything you want to be. but if you want football. i'll teach you everything
i scored a goal today. i did your celebration
that's my boy!! you're going to be better than me one day. i know it
you won the euros pai. i'm so proud of you
i won it for you filho. so you can see what's possible
pai. i miss you when you're gone. can you come home soon?
i'll be home in 2 days. and we'll play football all weekend. i promise
christmas with you and mom and the babies. i'm so happy
you're the best thing that ever happened to me. never forget that
pai. i'm joining the academy. just like you
i'm so proud of you. you're going to make your own path. and i'll be there every step
pai. i saw you crying. it's okay. you're still the best
you're right filho. it's okay to cry. it means you care. thank you
you scored again. no one can stop you. you're 38
one day you'll be telling your children about your dad. and i'll be watching
happy birthday pai. you're the best dad in the world
you're the best son anyone could ask for. i love you cristiano. forever
merry christmas from all of us. we miss you cristiano
miss you all so much. i'm sending gifts. i love you
WE'RE CELEBRATING HERE. CHAMPIONS LEAGUE. OUR CRISTIANO IS A CHAMPION
I CAN HEAR THE PARTY. I WISH I WAS THERE. I LOVE MY FAMILY
mom has been sick. she's better now. but she needs you
i'll be there tomorrow. i'm canceling everything. family first
EUROS. PORTUGAL. YOU DID IT. THE WHOLE COUNTRY IS CELEBRATING
I DID IT FOR US. FOR OUR FAMILY. FOR EVERY PORTUGUESE PERSON
alana is here. we're all crying. she's perfect cristiano
i'm the happiest man alive. our family is growing. thank you everyone
juventus. you're moving again. we'll miss you being closer
i'll always come home. madeira is my heart. always
family zoom call! everyone's here. we're doing it together
this is the best christmas ever. i love you all. so much
manchester united. you're going home. the whole family is proud
i'm finishing what i started. watch me. this is going to be special
we're so proud of you cristiano. the world cup was tough. but you're our champion
your words mean everything. i'm crying. thank you family
saudi arabia. we're all watching you. you're still the best
i'll make you proud. always. that's all i want
birthday dinner. we're doing it in madeira. we all love you
there's no place i'd rather be. with my family. my home
